findings.quote: Under no circumstances is IBM, its Affiliates or its Subcontractors liable for any of the following: ... 2. loss of, or damage to, Customer's or any other entity's records or data.
findings.rationale: Cap is mutual at greater of $100,000 or 12 months' charges, but excludes data loss — the most likely failure mode in hosting — and no carve-outs for confidentiality breach, security incidents, or gross negligence. §6.0 makes §§5/9/10 prevail over the confidentiality agreement. The consequential damages waiver also carves out amounts owing for Services that would have been rendered but for Customer's breach, effectively one-way.

findings.quote: that is brought by a Services Recipient and is related, directly or indirectly, to the Services
findings.rationale: IBM's IP indemnity is limited to Materials and Base Components (not the Services), with a credit capped at 12 months of charges as the entire obligation. Conversely, Customer's indemnity under §8.2(a)(3) covers any Services Recipient claim indirectly related to the Services, sits outside the §9.2 cap, and the relief in §8.2(c) is garbled and omits ordinary negligence.

findings.quote: IBM does not warrant uninterrupted or error-free operation of any Service or that IBM will correct all defects.
findings.rationale: No service levels or credits; broad disclaimers of performance, capacity, scalability and secure operation; capacity planning shifted to Customer; and the §5.1 warranty has no stated remedy while implied warranties are disclaimed.

findings.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable.
findings.rationale: Effect of Termination addresses only payment; no obligation to return Content/data, cooperate on migration, or certify deletion. Recommend a 90–180 day termination-assistance period.

findings.quote: will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term ... unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term
findings.rationale: Auto-renewal for a term equal to the prior term with a 90-day non-renewal window and no price protection; recommend successive 12-month renewals and IBM notice of the renewal deadline.

findings.quote: Customer may terminate this Agreement ... for convenience at the end of any calendar month by: a. providing at least one month's prior written notice to IBM; and b. paying the applicable early termination charges
findings.rationale: Customer has a convenience right on one month's notice; early termination charges in Attachment A must be reviewed and capped.

findings.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM
findings.rationale: Assignment restriction is one-sided: Customer needs consent (with an acceptable M&A carve-out) while IBM is unrestricted and may freely subcontract; recommend mutuality and IBM responsibility for subcontractors.

findings.quote: If not specified, Materials will be considered Type II Materials.
findings.rationale: Undesignated deliverables default to IBM ownership; Type II licence is limited to Customer's U.S.-located Enterprise; and IBM's Type I licence includes external distribution and sublicensing.

findings.quote: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components
findings.rationale: Revocable licence to components the Service runs on, plus discretionary maintenance excluding upgrades, creates patching and currency risk; should be irrevocable for the term with defined patch obligations.

findings.quote: You also confirm that you are solely responsible for ensuring that any processing and security obligations comply with applicable data protection laws.
findings.rationale: No audit or third-party audit-report (SOC-type) rights for Customer against IBM's security posture; review recommends adding annual audit rights alongside security standards and breach notification.
The agreement contains no vendor insurance requirements; review recommends adding them in an operational addendum.

findings.quote: Not addressed anywhere: ... benchmarking, most-favored pricing
findings.rationale: No most-favoured pricing provision; review flags it as a potential addition, not a burden on Customer.

findings.quote: This Agreement will be governed by the substantive laws of the State of New York, without regard for its conflict of laws provisions.
findings.rationale: NY law and jury waiver are acceptable, but no exclusive venue is specified; consider adding NY courts and an executive escalation step.

findings.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
findings.rationale: No non-compete restriction on Customer; freedom of action expressly preserved.

findings.quote: Customer shall not resell the Services, in whole or in part.
findings.rationale: No exclusivity obligation, but the no-resale clause should be confirmed not to restrict Bluefly's normal e-commerce or affiliate/marketplace operations.
